subject: Post-demo: budget passback & SLO-driven tier choices
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@deepquery.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T17:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo today — followup

Thanks for the demo earlier — big +1 from the eng team on the throughput and the cost transparency. A few notes from our side that will help us evaluate pricing: 

- Monthly active users expected: 120k — ~420k requests/day at peak (front-loaded)
- Average request length: 350 input tokens / 400 output tokens (conservative)
- Expected monthly token volume (roundtrip): ~40M – 60M tokens
- Budget range we can allocate for inference (proof-of-concept phase): $3k–$6k / month

Couple of asks: can Redwood show a target $/1M-token tier that maps to our 40–60M volume and the latency options (50ms p50 vs 200ms p95) you touted? Also — curious on streaming vs batch impact for 400 token outputs; we generally prefer sub-200ms responses for end-user-facing flows.

Attaching a rough usage spreadsheet. Happy to sync live if easier.

—Liam

Attachment: deepquery_usage_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet, 14KB)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@deepquery.ai>
Date: 2026-10-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick demo today — followup (DeepQuery pricing asks)

Looping you both in — DeepQuery sent a short usage estimate and a $3k–$6k/mo POC budget. They target ~40–60M tokens/month. They care about sub-200ms p95 ideally (user-facing).

Immediate asks from Liam: 1) a target $/1M-token for their expected band, 2) two tiered options that trade latency vs unit cost (e.g., streaming/low-latency vs batch/discount), and 3) any recommended batching/kv-cache settings to hit p95 targets while staying within budget.

Can you propose a short write-up I can send back by end of week? I attached their estimate.

—Jasmine
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick demo today — followup (DeepQuery pricing asks)

Thanks — read the sheet. Quick calc (ballpark) based on their token profile (350 in / 400 out = 750 roundtrip avg):

- Volume scenarios: 40M tokens/mo => ~53k requests/day; 60M tokens/mo => ~80k requests/day
- Target unit economics (hosted):
  * Low-latency (streaming, dedicated vCPU path + low batch): target $/1M tokens = $95–$120 (higher infra cost, p50~40–60ms, p95 ~140–220ms depending on fan-out)
  * Balanced (small batching + KV caching 10–20% hit): target $/1M tokens = $55–$75 (p50 ~70–110ms, p95 ~160–260ms)
  * Batch-optimized (aggressive batching, prefetch windows): target $/1M tokens = $30–$45 (best for background/async; p95 can exceed 500ms under burst)

Recommendations for meeting sub-200ms p95 for front-facing flows:
- Prefer streaming/prefetch path with small batching (batch size 4–12, adaptive based on queue)
- Enable prefix KV caching for repeated system prompts/search context — expect 10–30% token reduction on outputs in many flows
- Use a Dedicated pool with burst capacity for peak windows — keeps p95 predictable, reduces fallback costs

I can produce a short two-option proposal (option A: streaming low-latency; option B: balanced cost-latency) with concrete $/1M numbers and an expected monthly invoice range for 40/60M volumes. Suggest include caveat about quantization/model variant if they opt for aggressive cost targets (batch/quantized).

—Karthik
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@deepquery.ai>
Date: 2026-10-15T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick demo today — followup (DeepQuery pricing asks)

Appended some pragmatic guidance for sales language and the ask on budget:

- For a $3k/mo POC budget: we should set expectations that they can test experience-level traffic at ~40M tokens but will need to limit concurrent user load and may accept slightly higher p95 during peak. Present as "experience validation" tier.
- For a $6k/mo POC budget: we can propose a small Dedicated reservation + burst capacity to keep p95 under 200ms across peak windows. Present as "experience + reliability" tier.

Concrete numbers to share (use exact phrasing for clarity):
Option A — Low-latency streaming (recommended if sub-200ms p95 is mandatory): $110 / 1M tokens => Estimated monthly: $4.4k for 40M; $6.6k for 60M (exceeds upper POC without compression).
Option B — Balanced (small batching + KV cache, p95 ~180–260ms): $68 / 1M tokens => Estimated monthly: $2.7k for 40M; $4.1k for 60M (fits POC budget range if they aim for the mid/low end).

Note: we should call out that enabling 15% token savings via KV/prefix caching or prompt trimming brings Option A closer to $94–$100/1M and Option B down into the $58–$60/1M band. Also recommend a short pilot run (2 weeks) with live tracing to validate p95 and adjust batch windows.

I'll let Jasmine send the external note.

—Vivek
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@deepquery.ai>, Elena Martinez <emartinez@deepquery.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: budget passback & SLO-driven tier choices

Thanks again for the call and for the usage estimate, Liam. Below is a concise proposal based on your 40–60M token band and the sub-200ms p95 preference. 

Two POC-friendly options:

1) Option A — Low-latency (streaming, small batching) — recommended if sub-200ms p95 is non-negotiable
  - Unit price: $110 / 1M tokens (before caching)
  - Monthly estimate: $4.4k (40M) — $6.6k (60M)
  - Expected latency: p50 40–60ms, p95 ~140–220ms (with dedicated pool + burst)
  - Notes: Fits best if you can stretch to the upper end of your stated POC budget or enable ~15% token savings via KV caching.

2) Option B — Balanced (small batching + prefix KV caching) — recommended to stay within $3k–$6k POC constraints
  - Unit price: $68 / 1M tokens (before caching)
  - Monthly estimate: $2.7k (40M) — $4.1k (60M)
  - Expected latency: p50 70–110ms, p95 ~180–260ms
  - Notes: Good middle-ground; will meet sub-200ms p95 for many realistic distributions if KV cache hit-rate ~15% and batch windows are tuned.

Next steps I propose:
- Which option (A or B) do you prefer for the POC?
- If B, can you confirm whether you can enable server-side prompt trimming / share a short sample trace to estimate KV win rates?
- We can run a 2-week pilot with instrumentation: production-like request fan-out, p95 trace collection, and a short readout at the end. We will share a follow-up Doc with rollout steps and an invoice estimate.

Attachments: SLO_pricing_matrix.pdf (two-option comparison)

If helpful, we can also schedule a 30-minute tech sync with our infra lead (Karthik) to nail down batch sizes and caching knobs. 

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
